chat.text: CFRG is not a substitute for therapy.

chat.text: Please consult your physician before engaging in CFRG activities.

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: #20: please don't call them wallets

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: #10: i don't see how any discussion of trusted displays is actionable for any protocol work we do in SPICE

chat.author: Bjorn Hjelm
chat.text: Support the use of Credential Managers.

chat.author: Orie Steele
chat.text: I like the idea of relating wallets.

chat.author: Orie Steele
chat.text: use AI, it makes everything go faster.

chat.author: Bjorn Hjelm
chat.text: Using the term “wallet” as part of a use case seems like a good compromise

chat.author: Orie Steele

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: CURIE is a URI compression  mechanism used in W3C stuff like RDF and JSON-LD.

chat.author: Henk Birkholz
chat.text: CRIs!

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: Sure, but please don't make CRIs rhyme with Curry

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: but this is SPICE, is it not?  Curry seems fitting

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: Hmm, spice goes into a curry, not curry into spice

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: The URL design was ingenious for making the identifiers business-card-capable.  How relevant is that here?  What is the reason why everything needs to be a string?

chat.author: Henk Birkholz
chat.text: We were actually calling them that way. We are to blame for not paying enough attention to w3c notes from 2010.

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: CURIEs have survived without a specification, that's how useful they are in a stringified world

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: i still don't understand what was wrong with it as a URI scheme; i didn't understand the IANA registration objections.  that's why i said "no objection"

chat.author: Henk Birkholz
chat.text: Maybe CRI are some inspiration here

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: it seems to me like IANA can delegate to the DEs for glue, and the market can decide whether glue is mismanged or not.

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: or, IANA can not do that, and SPICE can use _ instead of : and (hopefully) the same DEs would be willing to do the same work and the market can make the same decisions.

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: i'd rather have that stuff (including the ability to update the DEs) happen under the aegis of IANA than not.

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: but clearly i don't understand the blocker.

chat.author: Henk Birkholz
chat.text: Everything can be b64grified if u need a tstr

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: Henk: but which dialect of b64? :melting_face:

chat.author: Henk Birkholz
chat.text: Isn't there some I-D emerging that explain the 2x2 permutation somewhere?

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: Daniel: base64url...  All the rest is legacy, unless a human has to type it in (base32)

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: that's a very large legacy

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: Sure, for legacy formats base64classic is not going away.  For new designs? base64url

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: 6 people voted yes, 8 of which answered the second poll :-)
